title: LedgeX licence pack (P26)
description: Every jurisdictions/<pack>/licences.yaml validates against this. §7.3: 'Channel eligibility for any fact is determined solely by licences.yaml, seeded into licence + licence_channel and enforced by the composer (I6). Nothing else grants a channel.' This file's own shape mirrors db/schema.sql's real licence table plus the six real output_channel enum values (B10, P59C: corrected from 'four' -- 0031/C9 added analytics and model_training) -- not independently invented.

id.description: Must equal a real licence.id row for any licence a pack's active source actually references -- checked by make conformance. A licence named only by a blocked/deferred source may have no database row yet, same reasoning as sources.schema.json's own id field.

restriction.description: Mirrors the live use_restriction enum (0001) exactly.

commercial_use.description: Mirrors the live permission_state enum (0001) exactly.

channels.description: §7.3's own words: this is descriptive intent in the pack, never the runtime authority -- licence_channel (seeded from this file, then immutable, 0033) is what the composer's I6 gate actually reads. analytics/model_training (C9, 0031) are optional here since §7.2's own drafted licence entries predate them; a pack omitting either is not thereby wrong, just silent on that channel -- make conformance does not require them.
